description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of MongoDB instances
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例是否为自动付费
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-instance-auto-renewal-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-bp567b0000 --db-instance-type replicate --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the region ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The category of the instance. Valid values:

replicate: the standalone or replica set instance

sharding: the sharded cluster instance

Default value: replicate
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型。取值：
replicate（默认值）：单节点或副本集实例。
sharding：分片集群实例
parameters.name: db_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。取值：30（默认值）、50或100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer parameter. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

AutoRenew.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled for the instance.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled for the instance
AutoRenew.description_zh:
自动续费状态，返回值为：
true：已开启自动续费。
false：未开启自动续费

DBInstanceType.description_en:
The category of the instance. Valid values:

replicate: the standalone or replica set instance

sharding: the sharded cluster instance
DBInstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型，返回值为：
replicate：单节点或副本集实例。
sharding：分片集群实例

Duration.description_en:
The auto-renewal period. Unit: months.

This parameter is ruturned only when the returned value of the AutoRenew parameter is true.

You can call the [ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145979.html） operation to modify the auto-renewal period
Duration.description_zh:
自动续费的续费周期，单位为月。

当AutoRenew参数的返回值为true时，才会返回本参数。
您可以调用[ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145979.html）接口，修改自动续费的周期

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

ItemsNumbers.description_en: The total number of entries returned

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries that were returned on the current page
